sections.title: 6. Integration Gaps — Missing End-to-End Flows
sections.content:
| Scenario | What Breaks |
|---|---|
| `db → sync → store` pipeline | A report submitted offline should flow through `db.insertPendingReport` → `sync.flushPendingQueue` → store count refresh. No test validates the chain. |
| `db.web` vs `db.native` module resolution | Expo Metro resolves `db.ts` vs `db.web.ts` based on platform. No test ensures the same behavior across platforms. |
| `supabase → sync error → store` | A Supabase error in `submitReport` returns an error object, but the store never sees it. The user-facing screen relies on `submitReport`'s return value directly. |
| NetInfo state transitions | Online → offline → online cycle triggers listener. No test verifies the reconnect -> flush flow end-to-end. |

---

## Test Coverage Analysis: GIAL DSR Mobile

### Baseline: **Zero tests exist.** Every function, component, and module is untested.

### ❌ Framework Gaps (must fix first)

| Issue | Detail |
|---|---|
| No `jest.config.js` | Tests will fail on first run |
| No test preset | `jest-expo` or `@react-native/jest-preset` needed for RN environment |
| No setup file | `expo-sqlite`, `@react-native-community/netinfo`, `supabase` all need mocks |
| `tsconfig strict: true` | Test files must pass strict type checks |

**Blocked until** a `jest.config.js` with `preset: 'jest-expo'` and a `jest.setup.ts` with mocks for `expo-sqlite`, `@react-native-community/netinfo`, and environment variables (`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`) exist.

---

### Per-Module Gap Analysis

### 1. `src/lib/db.ts` — SQLite Database Layer (8 untested exports)

| Function | Edge Cases Missed |
|---|---|
| `insertPendingReport` | `verification_failure_reason` as `undefined` vs `null`; ID collision under rapid calls |
| `getAllPendingReports` | Empty table; only returns `'pending'` status rows (ignores synced/failed) |
| `deletePendingReport` | ID doesn't exist (no-op); ID is `''`; delete already-deleted record |
| `updatePendingReportStatus` | Update non-existent ID; `errorMessage` undefined when status is 'failed'; partial field update (only `status` changed, `synced_at` left null) |
| `refreshPendingCount` | Query returns `null`; table has 0 rows; table has only non-pending rows |
| `cacheMachines` | Empty array (truncates cache); `machines` param is null/undefined; transaction rollback on failure |
| `getCachedMachines` | Cache is empty; ordered correctly DESC; returns stale data after partial update |

**`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`**
The SQLite variant files (`db.ts`, `db.native.ts`) use different param styles for prepared statements — one uses positional `?` arrays, the other uses named `$i
